description: Rozlivy povodní 2024 is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Český statistický úřad. Geographical delimitation of flood spills in 2024 with selected statistical data on the population and housing stock. Coverage: Český statistický úřad. The portal shows the English title as "Flood spills in 2024" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Český statistický úřad. Its keywords include population, domovní fond, obyvatelstvo, 2024, spills, housing stock. The listing shows 5 download or service links in SHP, GPKG, GDB, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00025593/0e8668552e05bff1045273e948519b1c/distribuce/9be561e44c2ec5dd38e9a2b9e760645a/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
